statements.status_notes: CVE-2022-1210 is a denial of service when tiff2ps converts a crafted TIFF file with JBIG-compressed data: the JBIG-KIT decoder that libtiff calls tries to allocate the image size given in the corrupt JBIG header and the process aborts (https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/issues/402). Upstream closed the issue as a duplicate of issue 97 (CVE-2017-9937), where the allocation is attributed to the JBIG-KIT library rather than libtiff, and no libtiff fix exists; Debian lists trixie's 4.7.0-3+deb13u3 as vulnerable with no fix (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2022-1210). In the currently published DHI tiff build for Debian 13, libtiff.so.6 links the separate JBIG-KIT library (libjbig.so.0) dynamically on amd64 and arm64. Pending: a maintainer decision on whether upstream's attribution to JBIG-KIT makes this owner not affected; the CVE record is not tagged disputed.
